# my.com
> my.com is a consumer internet portal offering email, cloud, news, games, and related online services.

The site serves as a broad entry point to multiple products under the MY ecosystem, including communication, storage, entertainment, and informational services.

## Core Portal
- [MY Home](https://my.com/): Main portal homepage linking to MY services and products.
- [About MY](https://my.com/about): Overview of the MY brand and its internet services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://my.com/privacy): Privacy practices and data handling information for MY services.
- [Terms of Service](https://my.com/terms): General terms governing use of MY products and websites.
- [Support](https://my.com/support): Central support entry point for help across MY services.

## Mail
- [MY Mail](https://mail.my.com/): Webmail service for sending, receiving, and organizing email.
- [Mail Help](https://help.mail.my.com/): Support articles and troubleshooting for MY Mail users.
- [Mail Apps](https://my.com/mail): Product page for MY Mail and related client applications.
- [Mail Privacy](https://mail.my.com/privacy): Privacy information specific to the mail service.
- [Mail Terms](https://mail.my.com/terms): Service terms and usage conditions for MY Mail.

## Cloud Storage
- [MY Cloud](https://cloud.my.com/): Cloud storage service for syncing, backing up, and sharing files.
- [Cloud Help](https://help.cloud.my.com/): Documentation and support resources for MY Cloud.
- [Cloud Apps](https://my.com/cloud): Product overview and download links for MY Cloud clients.
- [Cloud Web App](https://cloud.my.com/login): Sign-in page for accessing stored files online.
- [Cloud FAQ](https://help.cloud.my.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about storage, sync, and sharing.

## News and Content
- [MY News](https://news.my.com/): News portal featuring current events and editorial content.
- [Top Stories](https://news.my.com/top): Curated top headlines and featured reporting.
- [World News](https://news.my.com/world): International news coverage and updates.
- [Technology News](https://news.my.com/tech): Technology reporting, product news, and digital trends.
- [Entertainment News](https://news.my.com/entertainment): Coverage of media, celebrities, and entertainment topics.

## Games
- [MY Games](https://games.my.com/): Gaming portal featuring online and downloadable titles.
- [Game Catalog](https://games.my.com/play): Browse available games and featured releases.
- [Game Support](https://support.games.my.com/): Help center for account, billing, and gameplay issues.
- [Launcher Download](https://games.my.com/launcher): Download page for the MY game launcher.
- [Game News](https://games.my.com/news): Updates, announcements, and event information for MY games.

## Mobile Apps
- [Apps Overview](https://my.com/apps): Directory of MY mobile applications and services.
- [MY Mail for Mobile](https://my.com/mail/mobile): Mobile app information for MY Mail.
- [MY Cloud for Mobile](https://my.com/cloud/mobile): Mobile access and sync features for MY Cloud.
- [Games Mobile](https://games.my.com/mobile): Mobile gaming offerings and related downloads.
- [App Support](https://my.com/apps/support): Support resources for MY mobile applications.

## Account and Authentication
- [MY Account](https://account.my.com/): Central account management for MY services.
- [Sign In](https://account.my.com/login): Authentication page for accessing MY products.
- [Sign Up](https://account.my.com/signup): Registration page for creating a MY account.
- [Password Recovery](https://account.my.com/recovery): Account recovery and password reset workflow.
- [Security Settings](https://account.my.com/security): Manage account security preferences and protections.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://help.my.com/): General support portal for MY products and services.
- [Contact Support](https://help.my.com/contact): Contact options for customer assistance.
- [Service Status](https://status.my.com/): Operational status and incident reporting for MY services.
- [Community](https://community.my.com/): User discussions, tips, and peer support.
- [Support Articles](https://help.my.com/articles): Knowledge base content for common issues and setup.

## Developers
- [MY Developers](https://developer.my.com/): Developer portal for integrations, tools, and platform information.
- [API Reference](https://developer.my.com/api): Reference documentation for available MY APIs.
- [Authentication Guide](https://developer.my.com/auth): OAuth and authentication integration guidance.
- [SDKs](https://developer.my.com/sdk): Software development kits and client libraries.
- [Developer Support](https://developer.my.com/support): Technical support resources for developers.

## Company and Legal
- [Company Information](https://my.com/company): Corporate information about MY and its operations.
- [Careers](https://my.com/careers): Employment opportunities and company culture information.
- [Press](https://my.com/press): Press releases, media resources, and company announcements.
- [Legal](https://my.com/legal): Legal policies, notices, and compliance information.
- [Cookie Policy](https://my.com/cookies): Information about cookie usage and consent practices.
